title: Mars Colony Alpha
premise: The first kid crew at a Mars colony keeps the oxygen, rovers, greenhouse and radio running through dust storms and a mystery signal.

companion.name: PEBBLE
companion.about: a small rover who beeps; its lines are beeps translated on Idris's screen

cast.TAKODA: pilot; daring, flies the drone and drives the rover
cast.COMMANDER OKAFOR: colony commander; calm, gives the missions

fragments.style: Middle-grade graphic novel panel, clean cel-shaded coloring, bold black ink outlines, rounded cartoon characters with big expressive faces, rich saturated colors, rusty red, dusty orange and teal palette
fragments.notext: Wordless art, all surfaces blank, no lettering, no numbers, no speech bubbles, one single continuous scene filling the whole image with no panel borders, frames, bands or split sections
fragments.esme: a girl age 11 with light skin, red hair in a short ponytail, a white and orange space suit without a helmet and a tool pouch
fragments.takoda: a boy age 11 with medium brown skin, long black hair in a low ponytail, a white and teal space suit and pilot goggles
fragments.leilani: a girl age 11 with tan skin, long wavy dark hair with a flower clip, a white space suit with green gardening gloves
fragments.idris: a boy age 11 with dark brown skin, short black hair, big headphones around his neck and a white space suit with a radio pack
fragments.pebble: a small six-wheeled rover robot the size of a dog with a round camera head on a stalk and a tiny scoop arm
fragments.okafor: a tall woman with dark brown skin, short gray natural hair and a navy commander's flight suit
fragments.colony: a Mars colony of white domes and glass greenhouses on red dusty ground under a butterscotch sky
